name: Ember and Jade
mood: old, weathered, natural light; Morrowind/Skyrim grey-brown stone that the torchlight colours
rules: ground and walls are muted: no neon, no pure white, no pure black
colour is an accent (jade, ember, ice, blood, gold), never the whole surface
every surface has detail at two scales: big shapes plus fine grain
textures tile without a visible seam; effects fade to nothing before the edge of their picture
props are low-poly with a clear silhouette and stand on y = 0
